hypothesis_origin: Prior 2024 attribution; 2024 is reused development evidence, not an untouched test.
benchmark_scope: The fixed 24 previously documented instrument/lane leaders; no strategy, risk or sizing search.

selection.scope: Per fixed benchmark, using training folds only
selection.rank: Maximum worst training account net P/L across both years and all three cost cases; prefer the more conservative earlier-listed policy on a tie
selection.chronological_diagnostic: Also choose using 2022 alone and report its already-used 2023 development result
selection.promotion: Disabled; fresh evidence, calendar timing and observed execution-cost proof remain required

unchanged_guards.holiday: Full provider calendar day with original 60/30 buffers
unchanged_guards.uncertain_currency_or_high_impact_global: Full provider calendar day with original 60/30 or 90/60 buffers
unchanged_guards.entry: Next minute after a fully closed signal; preserve session trade caps
unchanged_guards.exit: Preceding safe minute close before a blackout; always flat by lane cutoff

global_medium_definition: source_currency == All AND impact == medium, excluding any central-bank event or holiday; classification applies uniformly to all names and dates
calendar_data_policy: Never invent a precise timestamp for a tentative event; do not mutate the original calendar
unverified_spread_guard: Full-period bid/ask spreads are unavailable; liquidity re-entry cannot be claimed verified and no paper/live promotion is enabled
